integrity.computational_role: supplementary finite checks, not an infinite proof

scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted cycles with graph-distance W1 and unnormalized generator only. Taylor error estimates are fixed-size, not uniform; weighted cycles and other transport exponents are excluded. Older equivalent cycle-specific heat-transport arguments remain a possible historical priority risk.
title: High-order flatness and exact transport contraction for cycle heat semigroups
